paragraphs.text: Where our Lord Jesus Christ, who took upon Him to die for all, stretched forth His hands, not somewhere on the earth beneath, but in the air itself, in order that the Salvation effected by the Cross might be shown to be for all men everywhere: destroying the devil who was working in the air: and that He might consecrate our road up to Heaven, and make it free.

source.source_note: Source. Translated by R. Payne-Smith. From Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Vol. 4. Edited by Philip Schaff and Henry Wace. latex.p0003: 我们的主耶稣基督，为了众人而受死，伸开双手，不是在地上某处，而是在空中，为要显示那由十字架完成的救恩\OriginalTerm{救恩}{Salvation}是为全人类共有的：祂摧毁了那在空中运行的魔鬼\OriginalTerm{魔鬼}{the devil}，祝圣了我们上升天堂的道路，并使之畅通无阻。
